sources: recreation.gov geo search (api/search/geo, campgrounds within 10 mi of the pin)

values.note: 8 sites, each with a tent pad, fire grate and picnic table. The FS page states no length limit.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/blacktail-creek-campground ('This is a small campground with 8 non-reservable sites'; 'each site includes a tent pad, fire grate and picnic table'), read 2026-10-28. max_rig_ft 33 cleared: it was derived from a camper review in the note, not stated by the FS.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/blacktail-creek-campground ('There is a vault toilet'; 'Vault Toilet (1)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/blacktail-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Weather Dependent (typically June-October)'; 'Open seasonally, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-28

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/blacktail-creek-campground ('8 non-reservable sites') + recreation.gov geo search (no Blacktail Creek facility; nearest listed campground Lynx Pass, 9.6 km), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $20 per site; exact cash or check only, no credit cards; payment instructions on the kiosk.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/blacktail-creek-campground ('$20 per site. Exact cash or check only as there is no option for change back if paying cash. NO CREDIT CARDS accepted. Payment instructions are found on the kiosk.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Small Routt NF (Yampa RD) campground right off paved CO-134 (Gore Pass) between Kremmling and Yampa, ~9,000 ft, about 14 mi east of CO-131. Open-meadow sites near Blacktail Creek; a reviewer fit a 33-ft rig (sites are unlevel). --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 8 non-reservable sites, vault toilet, potable water, $20 cash/check only; not on recreation.gov. Season as a note (typically June-October). Cleared max_rig_ft 33 (derived from a camper review; the FS states no limit). Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Max length: the FS page states none. The stored 33 ft came from a camper review quoted in the note and was cleared; the review stays in the note.
Pin 40.06825,-106.58022 is at the entrance junction ~130 m NW of the loop; the FS lat/lng 40.0672,-106.57955 is in the loop. Not a problem at this distance, but the FS point is better.
Not waterfront (stored) confirmed on imagery: Blacktail Creek is a willow-choked channel ~80-90 m west of the loop across meadow.
Status: 'Site Closed' badge on the FS page today; ordinary seasonal closing (typically June-October).
